title: Chair moved away
situation: She begins to sit; Shim pulls the chair away. Expectation, surprise and recovery have their own timing: the hips keep going down for a few frames after the seat has gone, then the weight is thrown forward over the feet and she stands up out of a deep squat.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
